guide.text: Nightwing's signature gear. Increases Attack and Crit Damage. Restores Energy on kills to trigger his Ultimate's follow-up strikes. Also converts excess Crit Rate into Physical Penetration, perfectly complementing his kill-refresh, reaper style.
